title: Restore existing glossary diagnostic photo thumbnails and images
user_request: Where are my photos for my glossary?
root_cause: Initial glossary UI implemented only text definitions despite data/learning-layer.json storing a real_photo reference for all 147 term records.
features: Illustrated thumbnails on glossary index cards
Full photo/diagram in each term definition popup
Existing focus notes, credits, source links
Optional draft anatomy pointers clearly requiring verification
On-demand Commons license checks for unknown source metadata
Safe fallback source links instead of unlicensed images
Preserve existing term data and licensed species photos

tests.commons_api_mock: CC BY-SA allowed / All Rights Reserved rejected

caveats: External Wikimedia images load in the viewer; not all image binaries are stored in the repository. Draft arrow positions are not marked final or verified. GFDL or unknown reuse restricted to source links unless a compatible approved license is verified.
publication: Use existing rights-filtered noncommercial GitHub Pages release, photo quality and permission checks. No canonical species, photo, Field ID, Quiz, or automation mutation.
